record.question: PFRDA stands for:
record.explanation: Answer C: Pension Fund Regulatory & Development Authority. PFRDA expands to Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority; the official authority itself uses this name. Reference: https://www.pfrda.org.in/en/about-us/authority/about-authority. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
